name: Paytm Payment Gateway
description:
Connect your Paytm merchant account to Claude for intelligent access to your payment operations. Look up transactions, search payment links, track refunds, review settlement status, and reconcile payments - all through conversation. No dashboard switching, no API calls.
Claude becomes your payments co-pilot - it works directly with your Paytm merchant account. Built for merchants, developers, and operations teams.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Paytm Payment Gateway to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Paytm Payment Gateway to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.paytmpayments.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Paytm Payment Gateway MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paytm Payment Gateway provides these MCP tools: fetch_all_orders, fetch_payment_options, fetch_card_bin_details, fetch_order_status, fetch_payment_links, fetch_transactions_by_link_id, fetch_refund_status, fetch_refunds, fetch_subscription_status, fetch_order_by_transaction_id, fetch_settlement_orders, and fetch_settlements_by_date.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Paytm Payment Gateway?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Paytm Payment Gateway in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Paytm Payment Gateway MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paytm Payment Gateway requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Paytm Payment Gateway is developed by Paytm Payments Services Limited. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
